content.short: Bridgesplit provides DeFi functionalities and interoperability to NFT projects.
content.description: Bridgesplit is building true interoperability across NFT projects, derivative markets, and decentralized finance by delivering a growing collection of APIs designed to unlock new use cases for NFT liquidity. It reimagines NFT trading on the Solana network, enabling users to put their NFTs up as collateral to borrow against those assets, or to fractionalize NFT purchases and share ownership. The project is backed by prominent investors, signaling confidence in Bridgesplit APIs as they aim to become a core piece of the Solana NFT ecosystem and the broader web3 liquidity landscape.
content.meta: Bridgesplit enables interoperability between NFT projects, derivative markets, and DeFi. Discover Bridgesplit and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
